en: two ints l and r – the inclusive range ⟦0⟧.
ru: Do ints l aur r – inclusive range ⟦0⟧.

en: Loops from 0 to ⟦0⟧, writing each element followed by a space, then writes a newline. An empty array yields only a newline.
ru: 0 se ⟦0⟧ tak loop karta hai, har element ke baad space write karta hai, phir newline write karta hai. Agar array empty ho to sirf newline output hoti hai.

en: Subtract the offset between ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧ from the base class pointer to get the derived class pointer.
ru: ⟦0⟧ aur ⟦1⟧ ke darmiyan offset ko base class pointer se subtract karke derived class pointer hasil karta hai.

en: Performs DFS from ⟦0⟧, marking vertices visited and storing their parents. When it encounters an already‑visited neighbor that isn’t the parent, it back‑tracks via ⟦1⟧ to assemble the cycle nodes, then aborts the recursion. If the search finishes without such a back‑edge, it returns ⟦2⟧.
ru: ⟦0⟧ se DFS perform karta hai, vertices ko visited mark karta hai aur unke parents ko store karta hai. Jab yeh aise neighbor ko dekhta hai jo pehle se visited ho aur parent na ho, to ⟦1⟧ ke zariye back-track karke cycle ke nodes ko assemble karta hai aur phir recursion ko rok deta hai. Agar search aisi back-edge ke baghair complete ho jaye, to ⟦2⟧ return karta hai.

en: Compute the integer part of √N using floor, increment it by one to get the next integer root, then square this value to obtain the desired perfect square. This works for all N ≥ 0; for negative N the behavior of sqrt is undefined.
ru: floor use karke √N ka integer part calculate karta hai, phir next integer root hasil karne ke liye us mein 1 add karta hai. Is value ko square karke required perfect square hasil karta hai. Yeh N ≥ 0 ke liye kaam karta hai; negative N ke liye sqrt ka behavior undefined hai.

en: The function brute recursively chooses the left element i for each pair, bounded by the previous left ⟦0⟧ and half of ⟦1⟧ to avoid symmetric duplicates. It checks that the right ⟦2⟧ does not exceed the previous right ⟦3⟧. On reaching the ⟦4⟧ the constructed array is printed and the program terminates.
ru: Function brute recursively har pair ke liye left element i choose karta hai, jo previous left ⟦0⟧ aur ⟦1⟧ ke half tak limited hota hai taake symmetric duplicates se bacha ja sake. Yeh check karta hai ke right ⟦2⟧ previous right ⟦3⟧ se zyada na ho. ⟦4⟧ tak pohanchne par banaya gaya array print karta hai aur program terminate ho jata hai.

en: If n is zero, return "0". Otherwise, repeatedly extract the least‑significant bit, prepend '0' or '1' to a result string that starts with a space, and right‑shift n until it becomes zero, then return the built string.
ru: Agar n zero ho to "0" return karta hai. Warna repeatedly least-significant bit extract karta hai aur '0' ya '1' ko result string ke start mein add karta hai. n ko right-shift karta rehta hai jab tak woh zero na ho jaye, phir tayyar ki gayi string return karta hai.

en: Prints two integers: the XOR of all n‑digit Armstrong numbers and the OR of all n‑digit Armstrong numbers.
ru: Do integers print karta hai: tamam n-digit Armstrong numbers ka XOR aur tamam n-digit Armstrong numbers ka OR.

en: Record indices of each ⟦0⟧ in vectors. For each character and each possible left boundary ⟦1⟧, binary‑search the first occurrence at or after ⟦1⟧; if found, all substrings extending to the end that include this occurrence contribute ⟦2⟧ to the total. Accumulate these contributions to obtain the final sum.
ru: Har ⟦0⟧ ke indices ko vectors mein store karta hai. Har character aur har possible left boundary ⟦1⟧ ke liye binary search karke ⟦1⟧ par ya uske baad pehli occurrence find karta hai. Agar occurrence mil jaye to end tak extend hone wali tamam substrings jo is occurrence ko include karti hain, total mein ⟦2⟧ contribute karti hain. In contributions ko add karke final sum hasil karta hai.

en: Takes an integer array ⟦0⟧ and its size ⟦1⟧.
ru: Ek integer array ⟦0⟧ aur us ka size ⟦1⟧ leta hai.

en: Allocate an empty string, call the existing three‑parameter overload to populate it with hex digits, then return the ⟦0⟧. Handles empty ranges by producing an empty string.
ru: Empty string allocate karta hai, phir existing three-parameter overload ko call karke us mein hex digits fill karta hai, aur ⟦0⟧ return karta hai. Agar range empty ho to empty string produce karta hai.

en: A single ⟦0⟧ s – the string to analyze.
ru: Aik single ⟦0⟧ s – analyze karne ke liye string.
